title: GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts silently ignores ?package= and answers the unscoped draft list, while its sibling metadata doors read ?package= and refuse unknown parameters
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · studio-authoring.meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows · observed beside the clauses

Found off-clause by the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`), beside #29180.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin bearer)

1. Leave one pending view draft.
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts?package=com.nope.nothing` → 200 with the unscoped draft list (the draft, `packageId: null`).
3. Contrast: `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts?packageId=com.nope.nothing` → 400 "'com.nope.nothing' is not an installed package…".

## Mechanism

`?package=` is the spelling the neighbouring doors read: `GET /meta/:type` and `GET /meta/diagnostics` use `metaItemPackageBinding(req.query.package)` and refuse unknown query parameters. `_drafts` reads only `packageId` (`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`, around lines 485–493) and has no unknown-parameter refusal, so a dropped predicate answers over every package: a silent widening, not a refusal.

Owning package: `@objectstack/rest`. Full evidence: #31486, slice C1.
